In almost all subjects in school, reading is an important part of achieving success, so it is important that you as a parent motivate your child to read. The app costs from SEK 58 per month. You test the app for free and can quit whenever you want.


The Penny & Friends app includes:


New exciting reading every month!

Every month, the child receives a new interactive magazine, and they also have access to previous magazines. Read about horses, animals, riding, friendship and much more.

Educational and fun games!
Each new interactive magazine contains a number of educational and fun games. By playing, your child is rewarded with points, badges and new levels!

A very own horse!
With the points, your child can develop and take care of their own horse and challenge friends!
